title: Performance of Foreign Subsidiaries of Kenyan Banks By

fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: REPORTING DATE, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The date for which the data is for. Format {DD-MMM- YYYY}

fields.name: SUBSIDIARY ID
fields.description: A unique identifer for the subsidiary of which the data relates to.

fields.name: SUBSIDIARY COUNTRY CODE
fields.description: ISO country code of Staff's denoting the country where the subsidiary is located. {As per ISO-3166-1}

fields.name: ECONOMIC ACTIVITY
fields.description: The economic activity associated with the lending, as per ISIC guidelines

fields.name: GROSS LOANS AMOUNTS
fields.description: Gross Loans Amounts (including accrued interest) per ISIC Economic Activity code.

fields.name: GROSS NON- PERFORMING LOAN AMOUNTS
fields.description: Gross Non-Performing Loan Amounts per Economic Activity as per ISIC
